rows.Origin:
Bred by Frank Bart Schuurman (New Zealand, before 2006).
Introduced in New Zealand by Franko Roses New Zealand Ltd. in 2008 as 'Spanish Sunset'.
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 2009 as 'Spanish Sunset'.
rows.Bloom: Orange. Bright orange suffused with yellow and yellow eye. None / no fragrance. 10 to 12 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, semi-double (9-16 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Compact, rounded. Glossy, dark green, dense foliage. 3 to 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for garden. Disease susceptibility: very mildew resistant, very rust resistant.
